title: Reverse-Engineer Competitor Blog Topics into a 30-Day Content Plan
oneLiner: Scrape top ranking competitor articles, extract search intent gaps they missed, and generate 12 differentiated article outlines.
problem: Marketers waste days writing generic articles that rehash existing Google search results without adding original value, resulting in zero search ranking and high bounce rates.
workflow: Pasted the top 3 ranking URLs for a target keyword along with their text content.
Prompted the agent to identify missing perspectives, outdated examples, and unanswered user questions.
Generated a 30-day editorial schedule featuring original angles and contrarian insights that rank faster.
prompt:
You are an elite SEO strategist and editorial director. Analyze the following 3 competitor articles on [TARGET TOPIC]:

Article 1 Summary: [PASTE SUMMARY 1]
Article 2 Summary: [PASTE SUMMARY 2]
Article 3 Summary: [PASTE SUMMARY 3]

Task:
1. Identify 4 common clichés and shallow points that all 3 articles repeat.
2. Find 3 critical unanswered questions or real-world friction points that all 3 articles ignored.
3. Propose 3 unique angles for our brand that offer superior depth and fresh perspectives.
4. Write a comprehensive outline for the best angle: Include an attention-grabbing hook, 4 core subheadings, and specific data points or real-life examples to include.

realityCheck.firstTryMistake: The agent initially proposed standard clickbait titles until instructed to write for knowledgeable professionals rather than casual browsers.
realityCheck.manualCleanupTime: 5 minutes to refine outline subheadings to match internal brand voice.
realityCheck.limitations: Does not replace primary research or direct customer interviews—use this to map the landscape before writing.
